approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 binary with the ReXGlue SDK, Linux/Vulkan build with FSR
notes: Playable on Linux: menus, story mode, cutscenes, combat and chapter select work, running at 60 FPS with the official 60 FPS patch, and DLC loads. No release binaries yet - you build it yourself. This fork is Linux-only; Windows players should use the upstream repository. No game code or assets are included - supply your own copy.
